case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 6470 OF 2022)
summary: Classification dispute: Base Oil (27101960) vs High Speed Diesel; conflicting test reports from Customs Lab, CRCL, IOCL; standard: strict construction of Tariff Act Supplementary Note defining HSD under IS 1460:2005; CESTAT wrongly imposed requirement of testing all 21/22 parameters; Customs Act s.111(d)/(m) confiscation applicable per preponderance; reversal of CESTAT affirmed; goods classified as HSD despite partial parameter testing; penalty liability upheld; redemption permitted with fine.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; CESTAT order set aside; Adjudicating Authority's confiscation order restored with permission for redemption on payment of fine.
